source_contract.variant: The same qualified FP8-only descriptor port plus fixture-owned validation callback in every cell; no configured-timer guard or old scoped-cache prototype.

fixture.selection: Prespecified first-layer MLP down projection from the same checkpoint and exact prior 144 input token IDs, before observing any tuning or execution timing. Verify actual dimensions and capture provenance.
fixture.source: Dense BF16 reference forward with actual captured post-nonlinearity activation; benchmark uses static per-tensor FP8 weights/activations through the SGLang linear facade.

source_contract.no_historical_pooling: Prior cohorts provide source/protocol context only; no historical or admission observations enter current estimates.

qualified_source.version_limit: Official fallback package0.0.0+unknown/unknown; exact source manifests and native artifacts establish identity.

scope: One bounded benchmark-only confirmation of each fresh MLP search explicit finalist against default; original winner/cache and production behavior unchanged.

native_reuse.restoration: Restore exact source archive plus the already-qualified tools and Python-only callback patch; restore entire native cache from the prior private archive. Never rebuild or change native artifact contents.
native_reuse.timestamp_amendment: Archive extraction loses subsecond cache mtimes. Restore eight object mtimes from their unchanged .ninja_deps records. Reconstruct two library filesystem mtimes from build-log timestamps; these are explicitly not claimed original library stat mtimes. Source archive mtimes remain unchanged; every source-owned dependency must precede its recorded build timestamp.
native_reuse.reason: Restore the already-qualified artifacts from durable archives without rebuilding; reuse the independently audited MLP fixture from the completed comparison.
native_reuse.isolation: Fresh process, home and tuner cache per worker; only compiled native artifacts are reused.
native_reuse.failure: Stop before measurement if archive/source/native hashes differ, a dependency timestamp is inconsistent, or actual pinned-container Ninja requires work. No implicit rebuild or load-only fallback.

protocol.finalist_selection: First minimum among the eight explicit candidates of the target M144 profile, keeping observed enumeration tie order. All original 81 measurements must be finite positive, as in qualified baseline. No replacement if finalist invalid.
protocol.natural_selection: Original first-pass actual cache winner; freeze before confirmation, verify actual memory lookup afterward and unchanged cache/file state. Natural choice must equal default or the chosen explicit finalist.
protocol.confirmation_objective: auto; no explicit measurement policy; same original warmup/repeat/L2/config
protocol.confirmation_decision: median(log(explicit_time/default_time)) < 0 selects explicit, otherwise default. No rounding or margin. Hypothetical decision only; never update original cache winner.
protocol.decision_freeze: Record original choice and cache hashes before confirmation; freeze confirmation role, descriptor, paired log ratios and median with timestamp/hash before any graph capture.
sequence: Original auto/synthetic MLP startup through SGLang wrapper: all nine profiles and nine candidates per profile; retain six target inputs only after final profile. Original initializer, no extra clone/copy.
Freeze actual original cache choice and dynamically select best explicit finalist using only original target profiling results.

Prepare reference and read hashes on retained synthetic inputs. Twelve balanced auto-profiler pairs on the same six tensor objects; NaN output refresh before and numerical check after every complete invocation.
Freeze hypothetical choice; verify original natural winner and cache state unchanged. Capture both explicit cache-hit and default cache-miss graphs in scheduled independent order.
Numerical/changed-input checks and 24 paired actual SGLang full-layer replay windows, retaining all outcomes.
Post-timing native acceptance on exact serving/synthetic operands; synthetic changed-input/restoration checks; trace the SAME original graphs; final cache/input/source checks.
protocol.admission: One disposable process with startup input hashes and integrity controls, excluded from performance estimates; timing requires independent admission audit.
protocol.original_input_history: Original dynamic initializer with metadata-only observation, matching the completed MLP comparison. No extra matched clone/copy from the earlier QKV confirmation study.

analysis.unit: Fresh process, n=8; same physical GPU, one fixture and contiguous time window. Within-process pairs are dependent repetitions.
analysis.counterfactual_comparison: Let original and confirmation indicators be1 for explicit and0 for default. Confirmation/original choice latency ratio is exp((confirmation-original)*L), computed from the SAME post-confirmation graphs. Unchanged choice is exactly1.
analysis.primary: Geometric mean of eight confirmation/original ratios, full range and per-process values, all original-to-confirmation choice transitions, and directional helped/hurt/unchanged counts.
analysis.secondary: Original finalist/default profile ratio, confirmation paired log ratio, held-out graph paired log ratio, original and hypothetical regret relative to measured best of the TWO candidates; not a full candidate oracle.
analysis.capture_order: Predeclared4/4 capture order and within-graph first-position strata; report all groups even when near zero or no decisions change. Capture/allocation/history are bundled; no causal attribution.

uncertainty.method: 100000 exploratory whole-process bootstrap resamples shared across metrics; seed202610262300; percentile95%, type7 quantiles.
uncertainty.limits: n8 within one fixed fixture/device/time window; no population, safety, equivalence or rare-error-rate inference. Directional helped/hurt counts are descriptive, not significance decisions.

analysis.no_pooling: No historical/admission pooling; preserve neutral and adverse outcomes. No timing-sign retries or expansion.
analysis.additional_counts: Corrected, introduced and remaining slower choices against measured faster of default/finalist on the same retained graphs; all eight original/shadow transitions and effect sizes retained. Graph signs are descriptive, with no new magnitude margin.
analysis.review_gate: Supports focused review only if corrected slower choices > 0, introduced slower choices = 0, and whole-process 95% bootstrap interval for confirmation/original graph score is entirely below 1. Otherwise stop this fixed cohort; no automatic production PR either way.

stopping.integrity: Stop and preserve failed artifacts; revise source/protocol explicitly before a separately identified new attempt.
stopping.performance: Do not stop, retry, discard or expand based on timing sign.
stopping.resource: One exclusive H100 node; bounded allocation; release after preservation.
stopping.selection_hypothesis: One fixed eight-process cohort only. Neutral or ineffective confirmation rejects this mechanism for the current checkpoint; no favorable-result retries, margin tuning or sample expansion. Any promising result remains fixture-specific and does not authorize a production selection change.

limits: Both original and hypothetical choices are scored using the same graphs AFTER extra confirmation; this is a choice screen, not unchanged-startup versus implemented-policy runtime measurement.
Dynamic finalist depends on first-pass profiling; confirmation candidate identity may vary across processes and is reported per process. It is not the fixed historical counterexample.
Retained tensor lifetime, reference preparation, NaN refresh and extra profiling change post-startup allocation/history; every process follows this declared sequence.
Profiler uses synthetic quantized inputs; full-layer serving graph uses captured activations plus quantization. This does not isolate input values, objective or host costs.

NaN checks surround full profiler invocations, including warmups, and do not validate every internal timed iteration independently. Serving graph traces do not observe every synthetic profiler invocation.
This no-margin median-log confirmation is a benchmark hypothesis only. No production selection rule, increased production tuning budget or general graph-policy recommendation follows.
No production changes, managed-store migration, scoped-cache prototype, distributed testing, model throughput test or PR.
